summary_1line: After the De Laceys flee, the Creature burns their cottage, travels to Geneva, is shot while rescuing a girl, murders William, frames Justine, and demands a female companion.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a stormy night the Creature whirls a flaming branch and ignites the abandoned De Lacey cottage as wind drives the flames over the roof.
The wounded Creature collapses in the forest after being shot by a man whose daughter he had just rescued from a rushing river.
The Creature grips young William Frankenstein by the throat in a dark field, the child’s locket glinting on his chest before the boy falls lifeless.
